decisions.reason: F9 and step 1.1 require a map R^4 to R, whereas thm-chain-rule permits only real-to-real composites. Replaced that load-bearing citation and dependency with the published thm-chain-rule-for-total-derivatives; continuous coefficient partials meet its total-differentiability hypotheses. The affine transition derivative is M, giving the stated gradient and integral invariance. The finite homotopy mesh cancels interior edges, local C1 primitives are C2, and uniqueness of path integrals defines the global primitive without Choice. Statement unchanged.

Clause (c) correctly defines an observer congruence as one smooth future unit vector field; clause (e) incorrectly identifies that object with an ordered four-vector coordinate frame. This is a nonfatal explanatory type error because the defining clauses (a)-(d) are unambiguous. Replaced the sentence by the separate tetrad identification and n=partial/partial x0=e0, with its constant-spatial-coordinate integral curves. No congruence, tetrad, chart or adaptation hypothesis changed.

The observer identity x′(s)=n(x(s)) differentiates a composite with target R4, outside thm-chain-rule’s real-to-real interface. Replaced its dependency and Remarks (b) citation by thm-chain-rule-for-total-derivatives, adding thm-continuous-partial-derivatives-imply-total-differentiability to identify Dn with its Jacobian. The open integral-curve interval and smooth n meet the hypotheses; tau′=1/c then gives U=cn, U′=c Dn x′=c a and A=U′/tau′=c2 a. Projection, decomposition uniqueness and L_n h=2 theta remain valid. Definition unchanged.

For x-rest worldlines with displacement (0,L0,0), equal primed times give Delta x0=0 and unchanged transverse length L0, contradicting clause (ii)(c) when v is nonzero. Completed its longitudinal hypothesis by requiring constant spatial displacement (L0,0,0); Proof 2.2 now explicitly solves Delta x0=(v/c)L0 and Delta x′1=L0/gamma. The existing claim and contract concern longitudinal rods; the new remark also computes arbitrary displacement (ell1/gamma,ell2,ell3), preserving the transverse caveat. F6 additionally overstated a scalar supplier, so replaced it by exact one-parameter derivative algebra used in Proof 2.4.

F11/F12 cited the real-to-real chain rule for maps with several inputs, including the implicit label and vector field along curves. Replaced it with published total-derivative calculus and explicitly supplied Jacobian hypotheses, coordinate-line derivative algebra, induction for smooth composites, positive square roots through the choice-free inverse function theorem, and exp smoothness/positivity. Checked the local coframe curvature and mixed identities, basic vorticity/acceleration, Cartan contraction giving da-flat=0, positive Killing rescaling, affine Killing dichotomy, and the implicit-label converse. Corrected two nonfatal proof qualifications: a local leaf is an open subset of its hyperplane, and partial_s f equals N only after evaluating at the label. Statement unchanged.
